in_marathi.name: Shrey
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory, Success, Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shrey हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘श्रेय’ (śrey), meaning ‘the best, most excellent, prosperous, fortunate, or victorious’. In Hindu mythology, Shrey is a term symbolizing success, prosperity, and victory, often used as a name for newborn boys. The name carries a deep spiritual significance and is believed to bring good fortune and success in life.
